snippet.title: IMAGINARIA - An Antarctic Adventure Game
snippet.description:
OUT NOW!
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1600550/Imaginaria/
ITCH: https://orbistertius.itch.io/imaginaria

PART OF THE LEFTFIELD COLLECTION AT EGX 2021

'Imaginaria' is a term describing both a night watch and the night watcher. You are in charge of Imaginaria duty tonight, in this forsaken Antarctic station.

Inspired by the developer’s experiences living in Antarctica for 15 months, Imaginaria is equal parts visual novel, point & click adventure, walking sim and documentary.

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/OrbisTertiusGms
And on our website: http://www.orbistertiusgames.com
